academic.passage: The theory of relativity, formulated by Albert Einstein, transformed scientific views on space and time. It comprises two main aspects: special relativity, which addresses objects moving at constant velocities, and general relativity, which includes the effects of gravity. The implications of this theory are vast, especially in understanding cosmic phenomena such as black holes.
